author: ShoroMagnate
quote: After more than a decade of waiting, the final result is deeply disappointing. The game suffers from severe FPS drops, constant bugs, and clunky controls that make basic movement feel outdated. On top of the technical mess, the pacing is painfully slow and bloated with repetitive filler missions that pad out the runtime without adding real fun. For a title with such massive hype and budget, releasing in this unpolished state feels like a huge letdown that fails to live up to the legacy of the franchise.
